visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a man with short dark hair in a beige t-shirt standing at the entrance of a Carrefour supermarket. He gestures enthusiastically with his arms wide while speaking to the camera. The background is bright with supermarket aisles and red promotional lanterns. (2) He transitions into the store, walking through aisles of snacks and pantry goods. Handheld camera movement follows him as he selects items like pasta sauce and frozen shrimp, placing them into a black shopping basket. (3) Standing near the checkout, he points toward a digital graphic of a credit card that appears on screen. The lighting is bright industrial fluorescent. He uses animated hand gestures and facial expressions to describe the card. (4) The scene shifts to a modern indoor kitchen where he is joined by a woman. They are seen at a stove stirring a pot of spaghetti and preparing a salad in a large glass bowl. (5) Finally, a group of people are gathered at a long table in an office-like setting, eating the prepared meal and laughing. They use chopsticks to lift noodles, showing happy facial expressions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins over a bouncy, major-key electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat. A sharp digital 'ding' SFX coincides with the first text appearance. (2) Vocal delivery is rapid and articulate as shopping items are listed. A distinct 'whoosh' SFX signals a scene transition. BGM remains constant at a bright energy level. (3) A new audio phase triggers with the sound of a plastic bag rustling. The host's tone shifts to an informative marketing pitch regarding a credit card. (4) The mix incorporates subtle kitchen ambient sounds: the sizzle of a pan and a low-frequency liquid bubbling sound. Male and female voices interact with high-valence laughter. (5) Final phase features a 'tada' style stinger SFX during the giveaway announcement, followed by a percussive slap sound used for comedic emphasis during the meal segment.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Shopping Challenge -> Product Integration -> Cooking/Tasting -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is an integrated marketing campaign for the CTBC uniopen co-branded credit card. It uses a popular 'budget cooking' format to naturally demonstrate the card's cash-back benefits and promotional offers while shopping at Carrefour, concluding with a call-to-action to participate in a lucky draw.
